title: SEBI Revamps Securities Lending Scheme, Launches Setu Portal & Bond Tokenisation Pilot
summary: Modernizes securities borrowing infrastructure, digital compliance filing, and blockchain corporate bond issuance.

blocks.content: Modernizes securities borrowing infrastructure, digital compliance filing, and blockchain corporate bond issuance.

items: Setu Portal: Centralized online compliance and registration portal for SEBI-regulated intermediaries.
Tokenisation Pilot: Corporate bond tokenisation using Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT).

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: ⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
